stories.title: Op ed: Beyond the Battlefield: How strategic centralization deepens Somalia’s political, security crisis
stories.description: Somalia’s worsening security crisis is increasingly rooted in political fragmentation, contested federal authority, and declining public trust, rather than military weakness alone, writes Adam Daud Ahmed. He argues that disputes between Mogadishu and regional administrations, coupled with the government’s failure to sustain liberated communities, are creating opportunities for Al Shabaab to regain influence. The author notes, "Somalia risks continuing to win battles while losing the political foundations necessary to win the war."

stories.description: Danjiraha Dowladda Turkiga u fadhiya Soomaaliya, Ferhat Alkan, ayaa kulan la yeeshay Danjiraha Dowladda Masar ee Soomaaliya, Maxamed Saalax Keshtah, kaas oo ay kaga wada hadleen xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed ee dalalkooda…
stories.excerpt: Danjiraha Dowladda Turkiga u fadhiya Soomaaliya, Ferhat Alkan, ayaa kulan la yeeshay Danjiraha Dowladda Masar ee Soomaaliya, Maxamed Saalax Keshtah, kaas oo ay kaga wada hadleen xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed ee dalalkooda… Danjiraha Dowladda Turkiga u fadhiya Soomaaliya, Ferhat Alkan, ayaa kulan la yeeshay Danjiraha Dowladda Masar ee Soomaaliya, Maxamed Saalax Keshtah, kaas oo ay kaga wada hadleen xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed ee dalalkooda la leeyihiin Soomaaliya. Kulanka ayaa labada danjire waxay isku weydaarsadeen aragtiyo ku saabsan xiriirka laba geesoodka ah ee u dhexeeya Turkiga iyo Soomaaliya, iyo sidoo kale Masar iyo Soomaaliya. Sidoo kale, waxay ka wada hadleen xaaladihii ugu dambeeyay ee gobolka iyo isbeddellada siyaasadeed ee ka socda, iyagoo diiradda saaray arrimaha khuseeya iskaashiga iyo xiriirka dalalka gobolka. Kulankan ayaa qeyb ka ah xiriirrada diblomaasiyadeed iyo wada-tashiyada ay wadaan wakiillada dalalka saaxiibka la ah Soomaaliya.

stories.description: NEW YORK (Goobjoog News) — Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay ayaa maanta oo Talaado ah, 17-ka Nofeembar 2026, kulan gaar ah ka yeelanaya xaaladda Soomaaliya, iyadoo diiradda ugu weyn la…
stories.excerpt: NEW YORK (Goobjoog News) — Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay ayaa maanta oo Talaado ah, 17-ka Nofeembar 2026, kulan gaar ah ka yeelanaya xaaladda Soomaaliya, iyadoo diiradda ugu weyn la… NEW YORK (Goobjoog News) — Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay ayaa maanta oo Talaado ah, 17-ka Nofeembar 2026, kulan gaar ah ka yeelanaya xaaladda Soomaaliya, iyadoo diiradda ugu weyn la saarayo mustaqbalka Hawlgalka Taageerada iyo Xasillinta Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya AUSSOM. Kulanka oo lagu qabanayo xarunta Qaramada Midoobay 10:00 subaxnimo waqtiga New York—6:00 fiidnimo waqtiga Muqdisho wuxuu ahaanayaa mid xiran oo aan si toos ah loogu baahin doonin warbaahinta. Jadwalka rasmiga ah wuxuu kulanka ku qorayaa ajandaha guud ee “Xaaladda Soomaaliya.” Goluhu wuxuu warbixin ka dhageysan doonaa Martin Kimani, oo ah Kaaliyaha Xoghayaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay u qaabilsan Afrika ee waaxyaha siyaasadda, nabad-dhisidda iyo hawlgallada nabadda. Waxaa sidoo kale warbixin jeedinaya El Hadji Ibrahima Diene

stories.title: La Juve mostra i progressi di Yildiz con il pallone: "Un passo alla volta, Kenan"
stories.description: Cresce l'attesa per il ritorno in campo del turco. Il club bianconero ha pubblicato un video su social: i dettagli
stories.excerpt: L'attesa è alle stelle. Il mondo Juve aspetta il ritorno in campo di Kenan Yildiz, fermo ai box dallo scorso 23 agosto, quando a Frosinone si fermò a causa di una frattura della base del quinto metatarso del piede sinistro che lo ha costretto all'intervento chirurgico. Da quel momento in poi la stella bianconera non è più stata a disposizione di Spalletti. Un'assenza che si è fatta sentire. Alla Juve la sua classe manca come l'aria. Attraverso i propri profili social, la Juve ha mostrato i miglioramenti Yildiz nel suo lungo percorso di recupero dall'infortunio. "Un passo alla volta, Kenan", è il messaggio a corredo di un video in cui si vede il fantasista al lavoro alla Continassa con il pallone tra i piedi. Una buona notizia, aspettando di vedere il nome di Kenan nella lista dei convocati di Spalletti. "Torno a dicembre" ha recentemente dichiarato il turco. Insomma, mancano davvero poche settimane per rivederlo a pieno regime con la maglia bianconera addosso.

stories.title: L'ÉDITO DE BABA. Pourquoi son combat face à Josh Hokit grave la place de Ciryl Gane dans l'histoire de l'UFC
stories.description: Au Madison Square Garden, Ciryl Gane a conservé sa ceinture des poids lourds (-120kg) de l'UFC face à Josh Hokit dans la nuit de samedi à dimanche. Et ce après avoir livré une bataille qui pourrait changer à jamais la perception de sa carrière.
stories.excerpt: Il y a les victoires qui enrichissent un palmarès. Et puis celles qui construisent une légende. Celles pour lesquelles on se souvient avec qui on était et où on l’a regardé. Dans quelques années, lorsqu'on parlera de Ciryl Gane, on parlera de ses titres et de sa riche carrière. Mais je suis convaincu que rapidement, on reviendra sur cette folle nuit new-yorkaise face à Josh Hokit. "Bon Gamin" possède désormais quelque chose qu'une ceinture à elle seule ne peut pas offrir: son grand combat de championnat. On connaissait le Gane fluide, précis, mobile, ce poids lourd unique en son genre au style de poids moyen. On connaissait aussi ses limites supposées: ces soirées contre Francis Ngannou et Jon Jones qui avaient laissé l'impression d'un superbe technicien à qui il manquait quelque chose lorsque le combat lui échappait. Et la lutte, sur laquelle il a tellement travaillé depuis. Josh Hokit a choisi d’appuyer exactement là où ces questions faisaient mal. Une pression permanente, un rythme

stories.description: Tripletta per l'attaccante del Real Madrid. Il commissario tecnico, squalificato, ha seguito la gara dalla tribuna
stories.excerpt: La sosta per le nazionali si chiude con una larga vittoria per il Brasile di Carlo Ancelotti. Dopo la sconfitta contro il Giappone e le conseguenti critiche, la selezione verdeoro nella seconda amichevole ha battuto largamente Singapore per 7-0. Anche se da Bogliasco si guarda, com'è giusto che sia, solo alla prossima partita di sabato pomeriggio col Benevento, da qui a un mese e mezzo i blucerchiati potranno finalmente giocare col favore del calendario. stories.description: Annual meteor shower peaks Nov. 17-18, with up to 15 meteors per hour possible under ideal conditions
stories.excerpt: One of the year’s fastest meteor showers is lighting up the night sky this week as Earth crosses a trail of ancient comet debris, giving skywatchers around the world a chance to see brief flashes of light overhead. The Leonid meteor shower is expected to peak Nov. 17-18, with as many as 15 meteors per hour under ideal conditions, according to NASA. Most observers, however, are likely to see fewer. Here is what to know about the celestial event and how to watch it. The Leonids occur every November when Earth passes through a stream of dust and small particles left behind by Comet 55P/Tempel-Tuttle, which orbits the sun approximately every 33 years. As the particles enter Earth’s atmosphere at high speeds, they heat up and produce bright streaks of light commonly called shooting stars. Despite their name, these are not stars falling from the sky. The shower takes its name from the constellation Leo, the Lion, from which the meteors appear to originate. The independent reporter earlier said he had been receiving death threats from drug trafficking gangs. He also used visitors to relay instructions to witnesses on how to testify in his separate trial on charges of war crimes and crimes against humanity. In one instance, Kosovo Liberation Army veteran Fadil Fazliu passed Thaci's instructions to a witness, telling him to deny receiving any messages from the former president if questioned by prosecutors. stories.title: Türkiye, Syria investigate unruptured fault lines after 2023 earthquakes
stories.description: Turkish and Syrian scientists are examining fault lines that did not rupture during the 2023 earthquakes to assess future seismic risks across the border
stories.excerpt: A team of 20 earthquake specialists from Türkiye and Syria has begun investigating cross-border fault lines that did not rupture during the devastating Feb. 6, 2023, earthquakes, seeking to uncover their prehistoric seismic history and assess the risks they could pose to both countries. Coordinated by Türkiye's Disaster and Emergency Management Authority (AFAD), the joint research brings together scientists from universities in both countries, along with officials from the General Directorate of Mineral Research and Exploration (MTA) and AFAD's Earthquake and Risk Reduction Directorate. The team has examined the Yesemek, Hacipasa and Reyhanli faults, which extend partly through Türkiye, alongside the Afrin, Sarmada and Armanaz faults in Syria. These structures are associated with the Dead Sea Fault system, a major geological fault zone stretching approximately 1,000 kilometers from Kahramanmaras toward the Red Sea. stories.excerpt: Efforts to tackle the growing burden of non-communicable diseases (NCDs) have intensified following the launch of an online petition pushing for measures to curb the consumption of unhealthy foods. Kenyans have been urged to sign the petition, which calls on the government to introduce mandatory warning labels on packaged food products high in sugar, salt and unhealthy fats. The Food Policy Coalition says the proposed front-of-pack warning labels will help consumers identify products containing excessive levels of nutrients associated with health risks, enabling them to make informed choices when shopping. Food Policy Coordinator, NCD Alliance Kenya, Anne Swake says unhealthy diets remain a major risk factor for NCDs, including diabetes and hypertension. She notes that 32 per cent of adults and 8 per cent of children in Kenya are overweight or obese. “We are not telling people not to eat; we are telling them to know what is in their food so that they make informed choices,” Swake says.

They say the common assumption that excess belly fat is solely linked to unhealthy diets overlooks other factors that influence how the body regulates metabolism, uses energy and stores fat. An independent commission of the Pan American Health Organization (PAHO), part of the World Health Organization (WHO), voted to revoke the designation after determining that measles had circulated continuously in the country for more than 12 months, according to sources familiar with the decision. The US achieved measles-elimination status in 2000, but the disease is now considered endemic again. PAHO is expected to formally announce the decision Tuesday. Noel Brewer, a public health professor at the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill, underscored the severity of the outbreak, noting that the US had recorded more measles infections over the past 18 months than in the previous 25 years combined. stories.excerpt: Ukraine struck a major bridge connecting Russian-occupied Crimea and the Russian mainland Tuesday for the second night in a row, while Russia hit two major bridges in the Ukrainian capital Kyiv. Traffic was halted for hours across the Kerch Bridge, which carries both automobile and rail traffic, after it was hit shortly after midnight on Tuesday. The bridge has been a target of previous Ukrainian attacks and holds symbolic value as it was built following Russia's annexation of Crimea in 2014. There was no official comment on the damage, but unverified social media images appeared to show a section of the road bridge completely collapsed and in the water. Russian military blogger Alexander Kots called the damage "significant" and said cars would not be able to cross it for a month. Kots also said the train service that runs across the bridge had been suspended, citing Russia's Ministry of Transport, but added the railway's tracks were intact. Five European Union countries have announced a deal with Rwanda under which it is set to host rejected asylum seekers. On Monday, Rwanda joined Austria, Denmark, Germany, Greece and the Netherlands in announcing the scheme in Vienna, with a plan to begin transfers by 2027. The governments say the deal would speed up the removal of people with no right to remain in Europe, while rights groups say it could expose vulnerable people to abuse. The five governments want to establish a “return hub” in Rwanda – a facility outside the EU where migrants ordered to leave member states can be transferred, even if they are not from Rwanda. The proposed scheme would apply only to people in the five countries who are subject to enforceable removal orders, including rejected asylum seekers. stories.description: The new rules restrict chip exports and also access to their computing power, which China relies on heavily.
stories.excerpt: As US President Donald Trump heads to China, his administration has renewed efforts to curb Beijing's access to advanced semiconductors. On Monday, Washington announced new interim rules that will increase scrutiny of data centre operators in Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia and Brazil. The move not only restricts the export of advanced chips, but also access to their computing power, which Chinese firms currently rent abroad to train artificial intelligence (AI) models. South East Asian countries in particular have invested heavily in data centres to power their AI ambitions - and Chinese firms seeking computing power overseas have been a key market. But now these firms will need a US government licence to buy advanced chips from Nvidia or other American chipmakers. This allows Washington to monitor if those chips are being used to serve Chinese companies, or being smuggled to China. stories.description: Serbia's defense ministry says that a military jet crashed northwest of Belgrade, killing the pilot
stories.excerpt: Serbia's defense ministry says that a military jet crashed northwest of Belgrade, killing the pilot BELGRADE, Serbia -- A Serbian military jet crashed on Tuesday northwest of Belgrade, killing the pilot, the defense ministry said. The ministry did not immediately give a reason for the crash. The MIG-29 jet crashed around 8:45 a.m. into a field near the town of Stara Pazova, some 50 kilometers (30 miles) from the Serbian capital, a statement said. Some local Serbian media published photos of the burning wreckage in the field and an ambulance and police cars parked nearby. Serbia's defense ministry statement said a special commission will work to determine what happened. The pilot, Maj. Goran Bulajic, was born in 1973 and had joined the army in 1996, it said. No other details were immediately available.

stories.title: Powering towns on pig manure: How Denmark has transformed energy generation
stories.description: Pigs are big business in Denmark. Now their waste is being turned into biogas, which powers the national grid.
stories.excerpt: Pigs are big business in Denmark. Now their waste is being turned into biogas, which powers the national grid. As the world seeks to cut carbon emissions to slow global warming, livestock manure is driving Denmark’s energy transition. Pigs are big business in the Scandinavian nation, accounting for a quarter of its food exports. There are as many as 12 million breeding pigs in the country at any one time – more than double the human population, and that ratio spirals if you account for 30 million more produced for slaughter and live export every year. Managing pig and cattle waste has long been a significant challenge. According to the Danish Agriculture and Food Council, Denmark’s pig sector annually produces more than 17 million tonnes of manure, mostly liquid slurry, emitting considerable amounts of greenhouse gas in the form of methane and nitrous oxide. However, Denmark has been engineering a biogas boom, developing facilities to convert livestock waste into renewable natural gas

rejected.description: A Conakry court has jailed 22 former local officials from the gold-rich northeastern Siguiri region, as well as 200 people accused of illegal mining. It's part of a wider crackdown that sent thousands fleeing into Mali.
rejected.excerpt: A Conakry court has jailed 22 former local officials from the gold-rich northeastern Siguiri region, as well as 200 people accused of illegal mining. It's part of a wider crackdown that sent thousands fleeing into Mali. Guinea on Tuesday jailed 22 former regional administrators and 202 others accused of illegal gold mining in the northeastern Siguiri region near the border to Mali. This comes as part of a wider crackdown on wildcat mining that has led to violent clashes and forced thousands of people to flee into Mali. According to the UN Environment Program, unauthorized gold mining is a source of income for more than 300,000 people in Guinea. The country's rich gold mines pull in workers from across West Africa. rejected.description: Bryson DeChambeau will play on the European tour for the 2027 season following the demise of LIV Golf.
rejected.excerpt: Bryson DeChambeau will play on the European tour for the 2027 season following the demise of LIV Golf. DeChambeau has taken Category 1 status, the tour said Tuesday, referring to its highest priority ranking, meaning the American can play in whichever tournament he chooses. DeChambeau had the option to join the European tour because he won a major -- the 2024 U.S. Open -- in the last five years. He was previously a star on LIV, which announced two weeks ago in bankruptcy court it plans to wind down operations instead of launching a new version after losing the financial support of Saudi Arabia. Before moving to the LIV circuit, DeChambeau was on the PGA Tour, which typically has a one-year ban of players dating to their most recent LIV appearance. On Monday, PGA Tour CEO Brian Rolapp said his board had "thoughtful discussions" about the future of players at LIV Golf, adding: "I hope to have more to say in the beginning of the new year."
